svg.text: impedance: why low, and why matched

g.text: The electrode and the amplifier input sit
one behind the other, and they share the
the signal. Losing signal is not why you
You chase it because a bigger resistance
hisses more — and because of this:

svg.text: the hum is identical on both inputs,
the hum arrives at different sizes,
so some of it survives the subtraction
